mapper.select:
/* selectAddr - Lee JiSeob */
Select
CTPV_NM || ' ' || SGG_NM || Decode(EMD_SE_CD, '0', ' ' || STTY_EMD_NM, '') || ' ' || ROAD_NM || Decode(UDGD_YN, 0, '', '1',' 지하', '2', ' 공중') || ' ' || BMNO_NO || Decode(BSNO_NO, 0, '', '-' || BSNO_NO)
|| ' ' ||
Case When (EMD_SE_CD = '0' And APTCPX_YN = '0') Then '' When (EMD_SE_CD = '0' And APTCPX_YN = '1') Then '(' || SGG_BLDG_NM || ')' When (EMD_SE_CD = '1' And APTCPX_YN = '0') Then '(' || STTY_EMD_NM || ')' When (EMD_SE_CD = '1' And APTCPX_YN = '1') Then '(' || STTY_EMD_NM || ', ' || SGG_BLDG_NM || ')' End
|| '|' ||
BSIS_ZONE_NO
|| '|' ||
CTPV_NM
|| '|' ||
CASE WHEN SGG_NM IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE SGG_NM END
|| '|' ||
CTPV_NM || ' ' || SGG_NM || ' ' || STTY_EMD_NM || ' ' || DECODE(STLI_NM, '', '', STLI_NM || ' ') || DECODE(MTN_YN, '1', '산 ', '') || LOTNO_MNO_NO || DECODE(LOTNO_SNO_NO, 0, '', '-' || LOTNO_SNO_NO) || DECODE(APTCPX_YN, '1', ' ' || SGG_BLDG_NM, '')
FROM
(
SELECT *
FROM SAD400 /* 도로명주소 - 중간조인테이블 */
AND CATSEARCH(ROAD_NM, #{keyword} || '*', NULL) = 0
AND CTPV_NM = #{si}
AND SGG_NM LIKE #{gu} || '%'
AND (BMNO_NO = #{no, jdbcType=NUMERIC} OR LOTNO_MNO_NO = #{no, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
UNION ALL
SELECT *
FROM SAD400 /* 도로명주소 - 중간조인테이블 */
And catsearch(STTY_EMD_NM, #{keyword} || '*', NULL) = 0
AND CTPV_NM = #{si}
AND SGG_NM LIKE #{gu} || '%'
AND (BMNO_NO = #{no, jdbcType=NUMERIC} OR LOTNO_MNO_NO = #{no, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
) C

/* selectAddr3 Lee JiSeob */
Select
A.SIDO_NAME || ' ' || A.SIGUNGU_NAME || Decode(B.EMD_GUBUN, '0', ' ' || A.LAW_EMD_NAME, '') || ' ' || A.DORO_NAME || Decode(A.JIHA_YN, 0, '', '1',' 지하', '2', ' 공중') || ' ' || A.BUILD_BONBEON || Decode(A.BUILD_BUBEON, 0, '', '-' || A.BUILD_BUBEON)
|| ' ' ||
Case When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '0' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '0') Then '' When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '0' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '1') Then '(' || A.SIGUNGU_BUILD_NAME || ')' When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '1' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '0') Then '(' || A.LAW_EMD_NAME || ')' When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '1' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '1') Then '(' || A.LAW_EMD_NAME || ', ' || A.SIGUNGU_BUILD_NAME || ')' End
|| '|' ||
A.base_area_no
From
( SELECT C.DORO_NAME_CODE, C.EMD_SERIAL, C.EMD_GUBUN, C.DORO_NAME FROM DR_DORO_CODE C
WHERE C.DORO_NAME LIKE #{keyword} || '%'
) B,
( Select C.BASE_AREA_NO, C.SIDO_NAME, C.SIGUNGU_NAME, C.LAW_EMD_NAME, C.DORO_NAME_CODE, C.DORO_NAME, C.JIHA_YN, C.BUILD_BONBEON, C.BUILD_BUBEON, C.UNION_HOUSE_YN, C.SIGUNGU_BUILD_NAME, C.EMD_SIRIAL_NO, C.JIBEON_BONBEON From DR_BUILDING C
WHERE 1=1
AND C.SIDO_NAME = #{si}
AND C.SIGUNGU_NAME = #{gu}
AND C.BUILD_BONBEON = #{no, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
) A
Where B.DORO_NAME_CODE = A.DORO_NAME_CODE AND B.EMD_SERIAL = A.EMD_SIRIAL_NO
/* AND ROWNUM <= 150 */
UNION ALL
Select
A.SIDO_NAME || ' ' || A.SIGUNGU_NAME || Decode(B.EMD_GUBUN, '0', ' ' || A.LAW_EMD_NAME, '') || ' ' || A.DORO_NAME || Decode(A.JIHA_YN, 0, '', '1',' 지하', '2', ' 공중') || ' ' || A.BUILD_BONBEON || Decode(A.BUILD_BUBEON, 0, '', '-' || A.BUILD_BUBEON)
|| ' ' ||
Case When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '0' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '0') Then '' When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '0' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '1') Then '(' || A.SIGUNGU_BUILD_NAME || ')' When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '1' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '0') Then '(' || A.LAW_EMD_NAME || ')' When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '1' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '1') Then '(' || A.LAW_EMD_NAME || ', ' || A.SIGUNGU_BUILD_NAME || ')' End
|| '|' ||
A.base_area_no
From
( SELECT C.DORO_NAME_CODE, C.EMD_SERIAL, C.EMD_GUBUN, C.DORO_NAME FROM DR_DORO_CODE C
) B,
( Select C.BASE_AREA_NO, C.SIDO_NAME, C.SIGUNGU_NAME, C.LAW_EMD_NAME, C.DORO_NAME_CODE, C.DORO_NAME, C.JIHA_YN, C.BUILD_BONBEON, C.BUILD_BUBEON, C.UNION_HOUSE_YN, C.SIGUNGU_BUILD_NAME, C.EMD_SIRIAL_NO, C.JIBEON_BONBEON From DR_BUILDING C
WHERE 1=1
AND C.LAW_EMD_NAME LIKE #{keyword} || '%'
AND C.SIDO_NAME = #{si}
AND C.SIGUNGU_NAME = #{gu}
AND (C.BUILD_BONBEON = #{no, jdbcType=NUMERIC} or C.JIBEON_BONBEON = #{no, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
) A
Where B.DORO_NAME_CODE = A.DORO_NAME_CODE AND B.EMD_SERIAL = A.EMD_SIRIAL_NO

/* selectAddr2 Lee JiSeob */
Select
-- DISTINCT A.base_area_no AS ZIP_NO,
A.SIDO_NAME || ' ' || A.SIGUNGU_NAME || Decode(B.EMD_GUBUN, '0', ' ' || A.LAW_EMD_NAME, '') || ' ' || A.DORO_NAME || Decode(A.JIHA_YN, 0, '', '1',' 지하', '2', ' 공중') || ' ' || A.BUILD_BONBEON || Decode(A.BUILD_BUBEON, 0, '', '-' || A.BUILD_BUBEON) AS DORO_ADDR,
Case When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '0' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '0') Then '' When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '0' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '1') Then '(' || A.SIGUNGU_BUILD_NAME || ')' When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '1' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '0') Then '(' || A.LAW_EMD_NAME || ')' When (B.EMD_GUBUN = '1' And A.UNION_HOUSE_YN = '1') Then '(' || A.LAW_EMD_NAME || ', ' || A.SIGUNGU_BUILD_NAME || ')' End AS ADDITIONAL
FROM ( SELECT C.DORO_NAME_CODE, C.EMD_SERIAL, C.EMD_GUBUN, C.DORO_NAME FROM DR_DORO_CODE C ) B, ( Select -- Distinct C.BASE_AREA_NO, C.SIDO_NAME, C.SIGUNGU_NAME, C.LAW_EMD_NAME, C.DORO_NAME_CODE, C.DORO_NAME, C.JIHA_YN, C.BUILD_BONBEON, C.BUILD_BUBEON, C.UNION_HOUSE_YN, C.SIGUNGU_BUILD_NAME, C.EMD_SIRIAL_NO From DR_BUILDING C
UNION ALL
Select -- Distinct D.BASE_AREA_NO, X.SIDO_NAME, X.SIGUNGU_NAME, X.LAW_EMD_NAME, X.DORO_NAME_CODE, D.DORO_NAME, D.JIHA_YN, D.BUILD_BONBEON, D.BUILD_BUBEON, D.UNION_HOUSE_YN, D.SIGUNGU_BUILD_NAME, D.EMD_SIRIAL_NO
From DR_BUILDING D, --DR_RELATE_JIBEON X ( SELECT G.SIDO_NAME, G.SIGUNGU_NAME, G.LAW_EMD_NAME, G.DORO_NAME_CODE, G.JIHA_YN, G.BUILD_BONBEON, G.BUILD_BUBEON FROM DR_RELATE_JIBEON G ) X
Where D.DORO_NAME_CODE = X.DORO_NAME_CODE And D.JIHA_YN = X.JIHA_YN And D.BUILD_BONBEON = X.BUILD_BONBEON And D.BUILD_BUBEON = X.BUILD_BUBEON ) A
Where B.DORO_NAME_CODE = A.DORO_NAME_CODE AND B.EMD_SERIAL = A.EMD_SIRIAL_NO And ( B.DORO_NAME LIKE '%증산%' OR A.LAW_EMD_NAME LIKE '%증산%' )

/* selectAddrArea - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT SGG_CD, CTPV_NM, SGG_NM, ENG_CTPV_NM, ENG_SGG_NM, SRTNG_SQNCE, DEL_YN FROM SAA020 ORDER BY SRTNG_SQNCE, SGG_CD

/* selectSidoArea - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT CTPV_NM, ENG_CTPV_NM, SUBSTR(MIN(SGG_CD), 1, 2) AS SIDO_CD, MIN(SRTNG_SQNCE) AS SRTNG_SQNCE
FROM SAA020
GROUP BY CTPV_NM, ENG_CTPV_NM
ORDER BY SRTNG_SQNCE

/* selectSgg - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT CTPV_NM, ENG_CTPV_NM, SGG_CD, SGG_NM, CASE WHEN SGG_NM = '*' THEN CTPV_NM ELSE CTPV_NM || ' - ' || SGG_NM END AS SIDO_SGG_NM_1, CASE WHEN SGG_NM = '*' THEN CTPV_NM ELSE CTPV_NM || ' ' || SGG_NM END AS SIDO_SGG_NM_2, MAX(SRTNG_SQNCE) AS SRTNG_SQNCE
FROM SAA020
GROUP BY CTPV_NM, ENG_CTPV_NM, SGG_CD, SGG_NM
ORDER BY SRTNG_SQNCE
